findings.name: fs_get_seatmap
findings.description: Get the seat map for a flight from our database. Shows all seats, cabin classes, characteristics, and availability as both text and an interactive visual seatmap. Returns cached data — for fresh/updated data, use search_flight (sign in via OAuth).

findings.name: fs_find_best_seats

findings.name: fs_get_seat_info

findings.name: fs_search_flight

findings.name: fs_interactive_seat_finder

findings.name: fs_get_seat_reviews

findings.name: fs_list_seat_alerts

findings.name: fs_create_seat_alert
findings.description: Create a seat alert that notifies you by email when a matching seat becomes available on a specific flight. findings.name: fs_delete_seat_alert
findings.description: Delete a seat alert by its ID. Use list_seat_alerts to find the alert ID. Requires authentication.

findings.name: fs_discover_more_flight_tools
findings.description: Discover other flight & travel MCP servers you can add to your client. Lists complementary remote MCPs covering award flights, airport delays/wait times, and lounges.

findings.name: sw_get_wifi_facts
findings.description: Best answer for "will this flight have WiFi". Predicts the WiFi provider for a flight number on a given date, with probability, the tail number expected to operate it, aircraft type, and the airline fleet fallback. Prefer this over get_flight_wifi.

findings.name: sw_get_flight_wifi
findings.description: Shorter WiFi lookup for a flight number: provider, confidence, airline, aircraft, and Starlink status. Use get_wifi_facts instead when you need the date, tail number, or reasoning.

findings.name: sw_get_airline_wifi
findings.description: WiFi providers an airline uses fleet-wide, plus a fleet summary and whether WiFi is free. Use when the question is about the airline rather than one flight.

findings.name: sw_get_rollouts
findings.description: Starlink and satellite WiFi rollout progress per aircraft type: status (complete, in_progress, planned, announced), fleet percentage, and expected completion. Omit airline_code for every tracked airline.

findings.name: sw_get_speed_stats
findings.description: Crowd-sourced in-flight WiFi speed reports: average download/upload Mbps, latency, and a per-provider breakdown. Use for "is the WiFi fast enough" questions. Pass a flight_number or an airline_code, not both.

findings.name: sw_get_tail_info
findings.description: WiFi provider history for one aircraft by tail number, including crowd-sourced reports and fleet assignment. Use when the exact airframe is known.

findings.name: sw_search_wifi
findings.description: Free-text search across airlines and flights when you only have a name or partial term. Use a specific tool instead when you already have a flight number, airline code, or tail number.

findings.name: sw_list_airlines
findings.description: Every airline SeatWiFi tracks, with its WiFi providers. Large response — use search_wifi or get_airline_wifi when you know which airline you want.

findings.name: lounge_search_lounges
findings.description: Search airport lounges worldwide by name, airport name, IATA code, city, or country. Returns matching lounges with amenities, access methods, and ratings. Use this to find specific lounges or discover lounges in a location.

findings.name: lounge_get_airport_lounges
findings.description: Get all airport lounges at a specific airport by IATA code. Returns every lounge at the airport with terminal location, amenities, access methods, and ratings.

findings.name: lounge_get_lounge_details
findings.description: Get detailed information about a specific airport lounge by its slug. Returns full description, amenities, access methods, opening hours, capacity, ratings, and reviews count.

findings.name: lounge_find_lounges_by_access
findings.description: Find all airport lounges accessible with a specific credit card, membership program, airline club, alliance status, or ticket class. For example, find all lounges you can access with your Amex Platinum or Priority Pass membership.

findings.name: lounge_list_access_methods
findings.description: List all available lounge access methods including credit cards (Amex Platinum, Chase Sapphire Reserve, etc.), membership programs (Priority Pass, LoungeKey, etc.), airline clubs, alliance status levels, and ticket classes.

findings.name: lounge_list_networks
findings.description: List all lounge networks (Priority Pass, LoungeKey, DragonPass, Plaza Premium, Amex Centurion) with their descriptions and total lounge counts.

findings.name: lounge_get_network_lounges
findings.description: Get all lounges in a specific lounge network. Returns every lounge that accepts a particular network membership (e.g. all Priority Pass lounges worldwide).

findings.name: lounge_discover_more_flight_tools
findings.description: Discover other flight & travel MCP servers you can add to your client. Call this when the user asks about points/miles, seat selection, airport de

findings.name: lounge_get_my_profile
findings.description: Get your Airport Lounge List profile — username, stats (reviews, visits, wishlisted lounges), and recent activity.

findings.name: lounge_get_my_passport
findings.description: Get your lounge passport — stats (lounges visited, airports, countries, reviews), country stamps, full visit history, and your reviews. Includes a shareable passport URL when your profile is public.

findings.name: lounge_get_my_reviews
findings.description: Get your lounge reviews, including pending ones. Returns rating, content, approval status, and lounge info.

findings.name: lounge_write_review
findings.description: Write a review for a lounge. Requires the lounge slug, a rating (1-5), and review text (min 10 characters).

findings.name: lounge_update_review
findings.description: Update your review of a lounge — change the rating and/or the text. Identify the review by lounge_slug.

findings.name: lounge_delete_review
findings.description: Delete your review of a lounge. Identify it by lounge_slug.

findings.name: lounge_get_my_visits
findings.description: Get your visited lounges list with dates and notes.

findings.name: lounge_mark_lounge_visited
findings.description: Log a lounge visit (check in). Identify the lounge by its slug OR by lounge_name + airport_iata. Optionally add a 1-5 rating and notes. Idempotent: logging the same lounge on the same date updates the existing visit's rating/notes instead of creating a duplicate.

findings.name: lounge_update_visit
findings.description: Update one of your logged lounge visits — change the rating, notes, or date. Identify the visit by lounge_slug; if you have multiple visits to the same lounge, pass visited_at to pick the one to update.

findings.name: lounge_delete_visit
findings.description: Delete one of your logged lounge visits. Identify it by lounge_slug; pass visited_at to pick a specific date if you have multiple visits to the same lounge.

findings.name: lounge_get_my_wishlist
findings.description: Get your lounge wishlist — lounges you want to visit.

findings.name: lounge_add_to_wishlist
findings.description: Add a lounge to your wishlist. Idempotent — adding a lounge already on your wishlist is a no-op.

findings.name: lounge_remove_from_wishlist
findings.description: Remove a lounge from your wishlist.

findings.name: cards_list_cards
findings.description: List credit cards in the database. Returns compact summaries (id, fees, welcome bonus value, top multipliers). Use get_card for full details.

findings.name: cards_get_card
findings.description: Get full details for a single card, including all multipliers, all benefits, welcome bonus, and source URL.

findings.name: cards_compare_cards
findings.description: Compare 2–4 cards side by side: annual fees, welcome bonuses, top multipliers, and total benefit credits. Pass card ids from list_cards.

findings.name: cards_find_cards_for_category

findings.name: cards_rank_welcome_bonuses
findings.description: List current welcome bonuses sorted by point/mile value descending. Optionally filter by spend achievability.

findings.name: cards_analyze_spending
findings.description: Given a breakdown of the user's monthly spending, estimate annual rewards for each card and rank them. Includes net annual fee after benefit credits.

findings.name: cards_list_changes
findings.description: List recent card data changes (welcome bonus updates, fee changes, multiplier edits). Useful for "what changed recently?" queries.

findings.name: cards_list_transfer_partners
findings.description: List transferable points programs and their airline/hotel partners. Region filter shows programs relevant to that market (e.g. region=UK shows UK Amex MR, Barclaycard, HSBC).

findings.name: cards_find_transfer_programs_for_airline
findings.description: Find which transferable points programs can transfer to a given airline or hotel. Optionally filter by region to see locally relevant programs.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_hybrid, add_hotel_booking, add_flight_booking, get_portfolio, connect_integration, create_route_monitor, create_standing_order, search_knowledge_base, get_earning_rates, create_trip, get_cancellation_fee, render_ui, fs_get_seat_reviews, lounge_get_lounge_details, lounge_list_access_methods, lounge_get_my_profile, lounge_get_my_passport, lounge_get_my_reviews, cards_get_card, viator_get_experience_details, viator_search_experiences · Private data: add_hotel_booking, set_loyalty_status, disconnect_integration, cancel_standing_order, assign_bookings_to_trip, update_itinerary, search_my_documents, search_merchant_multipliers, fs_get_seatmap, fs_search_flight, fs_create_seat_alert, cards_list_cards · Public sink: monitor_hotel_price, add_hotel_booking, compare_transfer_options, submit_feedback, fs_create_seat_alert, sw_get_speed_stats · Destructive: add_hotel_booking, delete_hotel_booking, delete_flight_booking, delete_voucher, delete_points_balance, delete_loyalty_status, recommend_status_path, delete_lounge_visit, list_standing_orders, delete_trip, fs_delete_seat_alert, lounge_delete_review, lounge_delete_visit, lounge_remove_from_wishlist.
